senses.gloss: अपौरुषेय a. (f. या) Not being of human origin, not made by men, of divine origin, as ग्रन्थोऽपौरुषेयः पौरुषेयोऽथवा Jaim.N.M.; अपौरुषेयप्रतिष्ठः M.M.ix. (not established by man).
